description: Verify the mounted editor identity and real rendered content.
Exercise English and German accessible modes and layouts.
Load all three examples and inspect the 36-frame Synthetic Orbit.
Import the existing PNG stills through the visible file picker.
Import a supported video through the visible file picker.
Cancel an actual file picker and verify no document mutation.
Pause, single-step, resume and abort actual reconstruction.
Finalize a completed reconstruction and inspect committed geometry.
Undo and redo the finalized reconstruction as one change.
Check independent windows and the same persisted artifact in the viewer.
Close and reopen the persisted artifact without an in-memory cache.
Inspect actual mesh export and download the QC JSON report.
